experience.title: Software Engineer (Application Developer II)
highlights: Sole developer of LSU's public .NET/SQL Server course browser (4.5K+ monthly users), taking it from Registrar mockups through feedback cycles and sign-off to production.

Redesigned the course browser's schedule data as a many-to-many model with the BI and DBA teams so sections with multiple meeting times display in full; let the Registrar set how far ahead courses publish.
Led migration of budget, inventory, and procurement applications off a DB2 mainframe, converting 164 SQL views and stored procedures to Workday-sourced data; all three live in 2025.

Ran old and new workflows side by side so any cutover could be reversed immediately, took the procurement app through user acceptance testing, then mentored two engineers through migrating two more apps.
Moved LSU's software download site to Entra ID SSO with SAML logout; built user impersonation into LSU's shared .NET library and dependent apps, so developers troubleshoot by seeing what a user sees.
Added xUnit unit tests for models, mappers, and view models to the course browser and inventory .NET rewrite.
Introduced Claude Code to the development team and wrote its shared setup and guidance; applied it with custom subagents and skills to the inventory .NET rewrite and a new Workday Extend app.

Replaced a legacy faculty-certification app with Workday Extend, prototype to production in 5 months; gathered requirements with program staff and made assessment questions editable without a deployment.
Rebuilt 7 JavaScript/TypeScript CKEditor 5 plugins for LSU's knowledge base editor (70K monthly visitors), adding keyboard navigation for accessibility.
